lines.zh: 地面每走一步都在颤。
lines.en: The ground trembles with every step I take.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵扫倒了三棵树。
lines.en: My ears knocked down three trees.

lines.zh: 草丛到我膝盖，我照样走。
lines.en: The grass reaches my knees; I walk anyway.

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，我越过整条河。
lines.en: One kick and I clear the whole river.

lines.zh: 我踩着祭坛的碎石往前走。
lines.en: I walk over the rubble of the altar.

lines.zh: 大地的裂缝跟着我延伸。
lines.en: Cracks in the earth lengthen behind me.

lines.zh: 我不绕路，我直接过去。
lines.en: I don't go around; I go through.

lines.zh: 脚步声在山谷里滚了两遍。
lines.en: My steps roll through the valley twice.

lines.zh: 走慢点，我要看清谁在发抖。
lines.en: Slower — I want to see who's shivering.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了半片田地。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the field.

lines.zh: 我坐着，山就矮了一截。
lines.en: When I sit, the mountain gets shorter.

lines.zh: 门槛太高，我低头才能进。
lines.en: The doorway is low; I must stoop to enter.

lines.zh: 有人在石头上刻了我的名字。
lines.en: Someone carved my name into stone.

lines.zh: 我的门牙在夜里也发烫。
lines.en: My front teeth stay hot even at night.

lines.zh: 那群小兔子叫我别靠近村子。
lines.en: The little rabbits told me to stay from the village.

lines.zh: 我留着祭坛，等下一个傻瓜。
lines.en: I keep the altar for the next fool.

lines.zh: 我数过身上的伤，一共十九道。
lines.en: I've counted my scars: nineteen in all.

lines.zh: 召唤石的光还没散干净。
lines.en: The summon stone's glow hasn't faded yet.

lines.zh: 我打个哈欠，树叶全落了。
lines.en: I yawn, and every leaf falls.

lines.zh: 这块地被我坐出了坑。
lines.en: I've worn a hollow into this ground.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵能听见山那边的鼓。
lines.en: My ears hear drums beyond the mountain.

lines.zh: 我舔一舔牙，尝到铁味。
lines.en: I lick my teeth and taste iron.

lines.zh: 你想量我的高度？够不着。
lines.en: Want to measure my height? You can't reach.

lines.zh: 安静点，我在想事情。
lines.en: Be quiet; I'm thinking.

lines.zh: 我磨了磨门牙，石屑掉下来。
lines.en: I grind my front teeth and stone dust falls.

lines.zh: 祭坛的石头又凉了一点。
lines.en: The altar stones have gone colder again.

lines.zh: 你抬头，只看到我的下巴。
lines.en: You look up and see only my chin.

lines.zh: 你手里的召唤石还热着。
lines.en: The summon stone in your hand is still warm.

lines.zh: 就是你把祭坛点着的？
lines.en: Was it you who lit the altar?

lines.zh: 别跪，我又不吃这一套。
lines.en: Don't kneel; that doesn't work on me.

lines.zh: 你的箭在我眼里像草籽。
lines.en: Your arrows look like grass seed to me.

lines.zh: 我认得出每个来过的人。
lines.en: I remember every single person who came.

lines.zh: 你退半步，地面还是震。
lines.en: You stepped back half a pace; the ground still shakes.

lines.zh: 抬头说话，别盯着我的脚。
lines.en: Look up when you speak, not at my feet.

lines.zh: 你身上有祭坛的灰。
lines.en: You've got altar ash on you.

lines.zh: 我不急着动手，你先说。
lines.en: I'm in no hurry; you speak first.

lines.zh: 你的同伴躲在那块石头后面。
lines.en: Your friend is hiding behind that boulder.

lines.zh: 眼睛别乱转，看着我。
lines.en: Stop darting your eyes and look at me.

lines.zh: 你的剑只划掉几根毛。
lines.en: Your sword only shaved off some fur.

lines.zh: 这一点疼，我记着。
lines.en: This little pain — I'll remember it.

lines.zh: 我的皮比你的甲厚。
lines.en: My hide is thicker than your armor.

lines.zh: 你砍到骨头了，声音很脆。
lines.en: You hit bone; it rang sharply.

lines.zh: 我挪了半步，仅此而已。
lines.en: I shifted half a pace — nothing more.

lines.zh: 流血不代表我要倒下。
lines.en: Bleeding doesn't mean I'm going down.

lines.zh: 这伤，换你一条命。
lines.en: This wound will cost you your life.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你手在抖。
lines.en: I look down; your hands are shaking.

lines.zh: 疼让我把你看得更清。
lines.en: The pain makes me see you more clearly.

lines.zh: 我身上的伤，都是这么来的。
lines.en: Every scar on me started like this.

lines.zh: 你举着胡萝卜，像举着旗。
lines.en: You hold up a carrot like a flag.

lines.zh: 那点东西，塞牙缝都不够。
lines.en: That wouldn't fill the gap in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我不吃小的，我吃整片田。
lines.en: I don't eat morsels; I eat whole fields.

lines.zh: 你手抖了，胡萝卜也在抖。
lines.en: Your hand shakes, and the carrot shakes too.

lines.zh: 拿开，我怕一脚踩扁你。
lines.en: Put it away; I might crush you reaching for it.

lines.zh: 召唤石的味道我更喜欢。
lines.en: I prefer the smell of the summon stone.

lines.zh: 你以为我跟那些小兔子一样？
lines.en: You think I'm like those little rabbits?

lines.zh: 甜味飘过来，我的鼻子动了。
lines.en: Something sweet drifts by, and my nose twitches.

lines.zh: 放下东西，退到十步外。
lines.en: Set it down and back off ten paces.

lines.zh: 这一口，会把你也咬进去。
lines.en: One bite of that, and you'd go in too.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的腿，像撞一堵墙。
lines.en: You hit my leg like hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 我被你碰了一下，没感觉。
lines.en: You bumped me; I felt nothing.

lines.zh: 让开，我的脚落下来很重。
lines.en: Move, my foot comes down hard.

lines.zh: 我退半步，你就能喘气了。
lines.en: I step back, and you can breathe again.

lines.zh: 你被弹出去，滚了三圈。
lines.en: You bounced off and rolled three times.

lines.zh: 撞我之前，先想想骨头。
lines.en: Think of your bones before you bump me.

lines.zh: 我的毛蹭了你一脸。
lines.en: My fur brushed all over your face.

lines.zh: 这具身体，你推不动的。
lines.en: This body won't budge for you.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的影子都会绊倒。
lines.en: You'd trip just stepping on my shadow.

lines.zh: 靠太近了，我的尾巴甩得到。
lines.en: Too close; my tail can reach you.

lines.zh: 这世上没有配得上我的母兔。
lines.en: No doe in this world is my equal.

lines.zh: 我独居，祭坛只容一个。
lines.en: I live alone; the altar holds one.

lines.zh: 那些小兔子怕我，不会靠近。
lines.en: The little rabbits fear me and keep away.

lines.zh: 我这一族，只剩我一个。
lines.en: Of my line, only I remain.

lines.zh: 我试过叫，山谷只回了一声。
lines.en: I called once; the valley answered once.

lines.zh: 繁殖是弱者的事。
lines.en: Breeding is a business for the weak.

lines.zh: 我的牙传不下去，也好。
lines.en: My teeth won't pass on. Just as well.

lines.zh: 谁肯跟一个踩塌山的家伙过？
lines.en: Who'd live with someone who flattens hills?

lines.zh: 我闻过同类的味道，很久以前。
lines.en: I smelled my own kind once, long ago.

lines.zh: 别问了，这问题我不答。
lines.en: Don't ask; I won't answer that.

lines.zh: 我捏起一块石头，它碎了。
lines.en: I pick up a stone and it crumbles.

lines.zh: 那根柱子我拔起来看了看。
lines.en: I pulled up that pillar to look at it.

lines.zh: 我拎起整辆车，扔到一边。
lines.en: I picked up a whole cart and tossed it aside.

lines.zh: 手指太粗，捡不起小东西。
lines.en: My fingers are too thick for small things.

lines.zh: 我把祭坛的碎片堆到角落。
lines.en: I piled the altar's fragments in a corner.

lines.zh: 这棵树挡路，我拿开了。
lines.en: This tree was in the way, so I moved it.

lines.zh: 我握了一下，铁就弯了。
lines.en: I squeezed once, and the iron bent.

lines.zh: 别把东西放我脚边，会踩到。
lines.en: Don't leave things by my feet; I'll step on them.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，只是想看有多轻。
lines.en: I picked it up just to see how light it was.

lines.zh: 手里这堆，够搭一间屋子。
lines.en: What's in my hands could build a house.

lines.zh: 你踏进祭坛的范围了。
lines.en: You've stepped into the altar's reach.

lines.zh: 召唤石一亮，我就认准了你。
lines.en: The stone flared, and I fixed on you.

lines.zh: 我闻到活人的汗。
lines.en: I smell living sweat.

lines.zh: 别跑，先让我看看你带了多少人。
lines.en: Don't run; let me see how many you brought.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁，铁会响，我听得见。
lines.en: You carry iron; iron rings, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 这片地现在归我盯。
lines.en: This ground is mine to watch now.

lines.zh: 我挑最大的那个先打。
lines.en: I go for the biggest one first.

lines.zh: 你举起了武器，那就定了。
lines.en: You raised a weapon; that settles it.

lines.zh: 我不用找，你自己送上门。
lines.en: I needn't search; you came to me.

lines.zh: 那座塔上的人也在名单里。
lines.en: The ones in that tower are on the list too.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声太轻，反而显眼。
lines.en: Your steps are too soft, which makes them obvious.

lines.zh: 我看见你往后退，来不及了。
lines.en: I see you backing away; too late.

lines.zh: 祭坛要血，我就给它血。
lines.en: The altar wants blood, so I'll give it blood.

lines.zh: 都站好，我一次解决。
lines.en: Stand still, all of you; I'll settle it at once.

lines.zh: 你手里的召唤石在响。
lines.en: The summon stone in your hand is humming.

lines.zh: 我转头，耳朵扫过整片林子。
lines.en: I turn, and my ears sweep the whole woods.

lines.zh: 四个人一起进来，正好。
lines.en: Four of you came in together. Good.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了祭坛的边角。
lines.en: You crushed the corner of my altar.

lines.zh: 我看见你身后还跟着谁。
lines.en: I see who is walking behind you.

lines.zh: 名单上的第一个，是你。
lines.en: You are the first name on the list.

lines.zh: 我跟得很慢，但从不落下。
lines.en: I follow slowly, but I never fall behind.

lines.zh: 你躲到树后，树就没了。
lines.en: You hide behind a tree; the tree goes away.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里最脆。
lines.en: I watch your knees; they're the weakest part.

lines.zh: 你绕圈，我也绕，圈子更大。
lines.en: You circle; I circle wider.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵一直朝着你。
lines.en: My ears stay pointed at you.

lines.zh: 你换方向了，我早看见了。
lines.en: You changed direction; I saw it first.

lines.zh: 追你比追兔子有意思多了。
lines.en: You're far more interesting to chase than rabbits.

lines.zh: 地面在震，你就知道我在哪。
lines.en: The ground shakes, so you know where I am.

lines.zh: 别指望天黑，我看得清。
lines.en: Don't count on nightfall; I see fine.

lines.zh: 你往河边跑，河不深。
lines.en: You run for the river; it isn't deep.

lines.zh: 我留了一条路，通向我。
lines.en: I left one path open, and it leads to me.

lines.zh: 你停下来喘气，我也停了。
lines.en: You stop to catch your breath; I stop too.

lines.zh: 我踩平了你刚走过的草。
lines.en: I flatten the grass you just walked through.

lines.zh: 再跑三步，我就出手。
lines.en: Three more steps and I strike.

lines.zh: 我的脚步放到最慢。
lines.en: I slow my steps to the barest crawl.

lines.zh: 你逃进村里，我就等村外。
lines.en: Hide in the village; I'll wait outside.

lines.zh: 我一低头，天就暗了。
lines.en: When I lower my head, the sky dims.

lines.zh: 你的箭射在我肩上，落了。
lines.en: Your arrow struck my shoulder and fell.

lines.zh: 我在数你的呼吸，共四下。
lines.en: I count your breaths. Four so far.

lines.zh: 你往左拐，我的耳朵先到。
lines.en: Turn left, and my ear is already there.

lines.zh: 一脚下去，地面凹了一块。
lines.en: One stomp, and the ground caves in.

lines.zh: 我的门牙擦过你的肩甲。
lines.en: My incisors scrape your shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 你被掀起来，又摔回地上。
lines.en: You're thrown up and slammed back down.

lines.zh: 这一拳能把你钉进土里。
lines.en: This punch could pin you into the dirt.

lines.zh: 我拍了一下，你的盾裂了。
lines.en: One swat and your shield splits.

lines.zh: 别站在我肚子底下。
lines.en: Don't stand under my belly.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的剑，把它折了。
lines.en: I bite your sword and snap it.

lines.zh: 你飞出去，撞塌了半堵墙。
lines.en: You fly off and knock down half a wall.

lines.zh: 疼吗？我还没用力。
lines.en: Does it hurt? I wasn't even trying.

lines.zh: 我甩头，你就滚开了。
lines.en: I toss my head and you roll away.

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，你连甲都翻了。
lines.en: A kick flips you, armor and all.

lines.zh: 我打你，是因为你站在这里。
lines.en: I hit you because you're standing here.

lines.zh: 你的同伴该来收了。
lines.en: Your friends should come collect you.

lines.zh: 下一击我不会收力。
lines.en: I won't hold back on the next one.

lines.zh: 召唤石落地，祭坛开始震。
lines.en: The stone lands, and the altar starts to shake.

lines.zh: 你把我从沉睡里叫起来了。
lines.en: You called me up out of sleep.

lines.zh: 土块翻起，我从下面站起来。
lines.en: The soil heaves, and I rise from beneath.

lines.zh: 这座祭坛又亮了一次。
lines.en: This altar has lit up once again.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，天边裂了道口子。
lines.en: When I opened my eyes, the sky split open.

lines.zh: 谁点的火？站出来。
lines.en: Who lit the fire? Step forward.

lines.zh: 上次唤醒我的人，骨头还在。
lines.en: The last one to wake me left his bones.

lines.zh: 我落在随机的地方，你运气差。
lines.en: I landed wherever I liked; bad luck for you.

lines.zh: 石屑还在掉，我已经站好了。
lines.en: Rubble still falls, and I'm already standing.

lines.zh: 大地让开，我出来了。
lines.en: The earth gives way, and out I come.

lines.zh: 我的重量先到，我后到。
lines.en: My weight arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 祭坛烧掉了一层皮。
lines.en: The altar burned off a layer of itself.

lines.zh: 你听见那声闷响了吗？是我。
lines.en: Heard that deep thud? That was me.

lines.zh: 别急着跑，先看我有多高。
lines.en: Don't rush off; first see how tall I am.

lines.zh: 祭坛裂了，我从裂缝里起身。
lines.en: The altar splits and I rise out of it.

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上的碎石和土。
lines.en: I shake the rubble and soil off my back.

lines.zh: 这一带的气味变了，我来了。
lines.en: The air here changed. That's me arriving.

lines.zh: 我的鼻息把灰吹成一圈。
lines.en: My breath blows the ash into a ring.

lines.zh: 醒来第一件事，是找召唤的人。
lines.en: First thing on waking: find my summoner.

lines.zh: 我的影子先压住了祭坛。
lines.en: My shadow settles over the altar first.

lines.zh: 火苗舔上来，毛焦了一片。
lines.en: Flames lick my fur and singe a patch.

lines.zh: 我踩空了，整座山都在响。
lines.en: I misstep, and the whole mountain rings.

lines.zh: 水只到我膝盖，别费劲。
lines.en: The water reaches my knees; don't bother.

lines.zh: 那股烟，我一口就吹散。
lines.en: I blow that smoke away in one breath.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我肩里，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder like a thorn.

lines.zh: 咒语在我身上滑开。
lines.en: The spell slides right off me.

lines.zh: 我饿起来，能吃光这片林。
lines.en: When I'm hungry, I could eat this whole forest.

lines.zh: 雷落在我耳朵上，麻了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits my ear and it goes numb.

lines.zh: 下面空空的，我抓不住东西。
lines.en: Nothing below; my hands close on air.
